title: The Huntress
author: Kate Quinn
summary: In 1946 a British war correspondent turned Nazi hunter and a young American girl in Boston both suspect a stepmother's past. The story follows a former Soviet night bomber pilot who became a killer.
readIf: you like well-researched wartime fiction told from several viewpoints, with a hunt at its core.
skipIf: you want a light read or find Holocaust-era violence too heavy.
